verdict.rationale: Browserbase's own docs say developers can "start building right away with 30+ ready-made templates", which matches the story directly. The evidence is a single one-line claim, though, with no detail on what the templates cover or how to use them. Missing for 10: documentation of template contents, languages, use cases and setup flow; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building immediately using a library of ready-made project templates
